bib.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models

read.skipped: Reference list (chars 42059-62824) skimmed only; few-shot exemplar tables 15,16,18-21 skimmed (not needed beyond pointer).

question: Can sampling diverse chain-of-thought reasoning paths and taking the most frequent final answer beat greedy decoding for reasoning in pretrained LMs?
hypothesis: Correct reasoning processes, even if diverse, tend to have greater agreement in their final answer than incorrect processes.
contributions: Self-consistency: a sample-and-marginalize decoding strategy replacing greedy decode in CoT prompting
Gains over CoT on arithmetic, commonsense and symbolic tasks across four LMs
Comparisons with sample-and-rank, beam search, prompt and model ensembles; robustness to sampling, prompts, zero-shot CoT

method.summary: Prompt an off-the-shelf LM with few-shot CoT exemplars, sample m reasoning paths with temperature/top-k sampling, parse each final answer, and return the majority answer. No training or fine-tuning.
method.task: Arithmetic, commonsense, symbolic reasoning; CoT-hurt NLP tasks

datasets.name: AddSub, MultiArith, ASDiv, AQUA-RAT, GSM8K, SVAMP
Last letter concatenation (4 words), Coinflip (4 flips)
BoolQ, HotpotQA (closed-book), e-SNLI, ANLI R1-R3, RTE
datasets.split: test split by default; not otherwise specified

inference.decoding: temperature sampling with top-k; majority vote over parsed final answers; baseline greedy CoT
inference.temperature: UL2-20B and LaMDA-137B T=0.5; PaLM-540B T=0.7; GPT-3 T=0.7
inference.samples: 40 outputs sampled independently per run, averaged over 10 runs; path counts 1,5,10,20,40 in plots
inference.prompting: Few-shot CoT as in Wei et al. 2022: 8 manual exemplars for all arithmetic tasks; 4-7 randomly chosen training exemplars with manual CoT for commonsense tasks. Outputs cut at next 'Q:'; parser takes text after 'The answer is '.

parameters.top_k: 40 for UL2, LaMDA, PaLM; none for GPT-3
parameters.aggregation: unweighted majority vote (also tested probability-weighted, length-normalised via Eq 1)

other.hardware: UL2 TPU v3 4 chips; LaMDA TPU v3 64 chips; PaLM TPU v4 192 chips; GPT-3 via API
other.time: 1-4 h per ~1,000 examples on UL2/LaMDA, 2-12 h on PaLM, no task over 2 days

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.definition: fraction of test items whose aggregated final answer matches the label (HotpotQA also EM/F1)

baselines: CoT prompting with greedy decoding (Wei et al. 2022)
eval.protocol: Mean over 10 runs of 40 samples; std reported in some tables and figures; no significance test

availability.weights: UL2 public; GPT-3 code-davinci via API; LaMDA and PaLM not public
availability.data: public benchmarks; exact prompts in Appendix A.3

prompts.purpose: Few-shot CoT exemplar for arithmetic tasks (first exemplar of Table 17, from Wei et al. 2022)
prompts.text:
Q: There are 15 trees in the grove. Grove workers will plant trees in the grove today. After they are done, there will be 21 trees. How many trees did the grove workers plant today?
A: We start with 15 trees. Later we have 21 trees. The difference must be the number of trees they planted. So, they must have planted 21 - 15 = 6 trees. The answer is 6.

prompts.purpose: Full exemplar sets for AQUA-RAT, ARC, HotpotQA, ANLI, e-SNLI, RTE, BoolQ
prompts.text: See Tables 14-16 and 18-21 in the appendix (not reproduced here).

results.claim: Self-consistency lifts PaLM-540B GSM8K accuracy from 56.5 (greedy CoT) to 74.4.
results.setup: PaLM-540B, GSM8K test, 8-shot CoT, 40 sampled paths, T=0.7 k=40, mean of 10 runs
results.table: Table 2, row PaLM-540B Self-consistency, column GSM8K (74.4 (+17.9))

results.claim: Gain on GSM8K with GPT-3 code-davinci-002 is +17.9 points (60.1 to 78.0).
results.table: Table 2, row Code-davinci-002 Self-consistency, column GSM8K (78.0 (+17.9))

results.claim: AQuA gain with code-davinci-002 is +12.2 points.
results.table: Table 2, row Code-davinci-002 Self-consistency, column AQuA (52.0 (+12.2))

results.claim: SVAMP gain with code-davinci-002 is +11.0 points.
results.table: Table 2, row Code-davinci-002 Self-consistency, column SVAMP (86.8 (+11.0))
Table 3, row Code-davinci-002 Self-consistency, column StrategyQA (79.8 (+6.4))

results.claim: On UL2-20B GSM8K goes from 4.1 to 7.3 (gain small at small scale).
results.table: Table 2, row UL2-20B Self-consistency, column GSM8K (7.3 (+3.2))

results.claim: On LaMDA-137B GSM8K goes from 17.1 to 27.7.
results.table: Table 2, row LaMDA-137B Self-consistency, column GSM8K (27.7 (+10.6))

results.claim: Unweighted majority vote matches length-normalised probability-weighted sum; unnormalised weighting is worse; weighted average much worse.
results.setup: PaLM-540B GSM8K; majority vote 74.4, normalised weighted sum 74.1, unnormalised 59.9, weighted avg normalised 22.1
results.table: Table 1, row Unweighted sum (majority vote), column GSM8K

results.claim: Sample-and-rank gains much less than self-consistency at the same number of samples.
results.setup: GPT-3 code-davinci-001, GSM8K/MultiArith/ARC-c, up to 40 samples; values read from Fig 3 only

results.claim: Beam search degrades AQuA accuracy as beams grow (23.6 at 1 to 10.2 at 40) while sampling self-consistency reaches 26.9.
results.setup: UL2-20B, AQuA, equal beams and paths
results.table: Table 6, row AQuA Self-consistency using sampling, column 40

results.claim: Self-consistency (40 paths) beats prompt-permutation ensemble (40) and multi-prompt ensemble (3 sets) on GSM8K.
results.setup: LaMDA-137B GSM8K: SC 27.7, 40 permutations 19.2, 3 prompt sets 18.6, CoT 17.1
results.table: Table 7, row Self-Consistency (40 sampled paths), column GSM8K

results.claim: Multi-model majority-vote ensembles are far worse than single-model self-consistency on GSM8K.
results.setup: Best ensemble LaMDA-137B+PaLM-540B 36.9 vs PaLM-540B SC 74.4
results.table: Table 10, row LaMDA-137B + PaLM-540B, column GSM8K accuracy

results.claim: Self-consistency repairs CoT harm on NLP tasks: e-SNLI 81.0 (CoT) to 88.4, RTE 79.1 to 86.3, ANLI-R1 68.8 to 78.5.
Zero-shot CoT with self-consistency (40 paths) on GSM8K reaches 69.2 vs 43.0.
Imperfect-prompt CoT drops LaMDA-137B GSM8K to 14.9; self-consistency recovers to 23.4.
results.setup: LaMDA-137B GSM8K, numbers in rationales randomised
results.table: Table 8, row Prompt with imperfect chain-of-thought + Self-consistency (40 paths)

results.claim: Robust to prompt set: GSM8K PaLM-540B gains +17.9, +17.5, +16.4 across three prompt sets.
results.setup: PaLM-540B GSM8K, 3 manually written prompt sets
results.table: Table 9, row Self-consistency, column Prompt set 3

results.claim: Combining SC with 40 prompt sets gives 75.4, with permutations 73.8; ensembling adds little over SC alone.
results.table: Table 11, row Self-consistency + different sets of prompts (x40)

results.claim: Authors advise 5 or 10 paths as a starting point since performance saturates quickly.
Consistency (% decodes agreeing with the aggregate) correlates with accuracy, usable as an uncertainty estimate.

limits: More computation cost: 40 samples per question (authors suggest 5-10 paths as a start)
Only applies where final answers come from a fixed set that can be compared
Models can still produce incorrect or nonsensical reasoning paths even when the answer is right
Gains small on small models (UL2-20B) where ability has not emerged
LaMDA-137B and PaLM-540B not public; only prompts released
Results on 2022-era models and code-davinci engines, which are no longer served

terms.definition: sample a diverse set of reasoning paths, then select the most consistent answer by marginalizing out the sampled reasoning paths

lineage.note: replaces greedy decoding in CoT; same prompts
